variants.name: header
variants.note: A column of the thirty is misnamed.

variants.name: unknown_target
variants.note: A row's identity names no packet target.

variants.name: packet_integrity
variants.note: The packet was edited after it was written; its packet_id no longer matches.

variants.name: packet_version
variants.note: A packet version this ingester does not read.

variants.name: packet_mismatch
variants.note: The caller expected a different packet_id.

variants.name: packet_unbound
variants.note: Neither a sidecar nor a packet_id argument names the packet the assessments were made against.

variants.name: stale_sidecar
variants.note: The sidecar names a packet other than the one being ingested: a stale file after a rebuild.

variants.name: no_pass_2
variants.note: A pass-2 assessment file is given, but nothing asked for a second pass. The test copies the pass-1 file to the pass-2 name and passes the packet_id.
